chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali from Uthman ibn Ahmad al-Sammak from Ibrahim ibn Abdullah al-Hashmi from Ibrahim ibn Hani from Naeem ibn Hammad al-Maruzi from Baqiya ibn Walid from Abu Bakr ibn Abu Maryam from al-Fadl ibn Yaqub al-Rakhami from Abdullah ibn Ja'far from Abu al-Malih from Ziyad ibn Bayan from Ali ibn Nufayl from Saeed ibn Musayyab from Umm Salama, who said:
I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say: 'The Mahdi is from my progeny, from the descendants of Fatima.'

key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: The Mahdi (the Guided One), a title for the awaited savior in Islamic eschatology.
key_terms.بَنَاتِ فَاطِمَةَ: The descendants of Fatima, daughter of the Prophet.
key_terms.عِتْرَتِي: My progeny/offspring, referring specifically to the Ahl al-Bayt.

ai.seo_question: Who is the Mahdi and from which lineage does he descend according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Tusi in *Kitab al-Ghayba*, explicitly identifies the Mahdi as a direct descendant of Fatima al-Zahra, reinforcing the Shia doctrine of Imamate through the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a foundational proof for the Twelfth Imam's lineage, linking the eschatological savior directly to the Prophet's progeny and establishing the continuity of divine guidance within the family of Ali and Fatima.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 145 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Ali from Uthman bin Ahmad Sammak from Ibrahim bin Abdullah Hashmi from Ibrahim bin Hani from Naeem bin Hammad Maruzi from Baqiya bin Walid from Abu Bakr bin Abu Maryam from Fadhl bin Yaqub Rakhami from Abdullah bin Ja’far from Abu Malih from Ziyad bin Bayan from Ali bin Nufayl from Saeed bin Musayyab that Umme Salama, wife of the Prophet said:
I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say: “Mahdi is from my progeny, from the descendants of Fatima.”
